title: NEB Class 11 Biology — Vegetation — 2022
subject: biology
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Describe the vegetation found in the Terai and Bhabar zones of Nepal, mentioning four important species.
questions.solution:
**Location:** The **Terai** is the southern lowland belt of Nepal, lying roughly between 200 m and 600 m altitude, running below the Siwalik hills. It is hot, humid and receives 150–200 cm or more of rain, most of it in the monsoon. The **Bhabar** zone lies between about 200 m and 400 m and is a belt of porous alluvium where many streams disappear underground.

**Vegetation of the Bhabar:** Open scrub and deciduous forest on the dry, porous alluvium — *Dalbergia sissoo* (shisham), bamboo (*Dendrocalamus*), *Acacia nilotica*, and the invasive shrub *Lantana camara*.

**Vegetation of the Terai:** Tall, dense **mixed deciduous forest** and **sal forest**, with some evergreen patches along the rivers (Karnali, Narayani, Kosi).

**Four important species:**
1. *Shorea robusta* (**sal**) — dominant canopy tree; timber tree.
2. *Dalbergia sissoo* (**shisham**) — fast-growing timber tree.
3. *Acacia nilotica* (**babar**) — thorny nitrogen-fixing tree of the doon.
4. *Bauhinia variegata* (**narikhaj**) — showy-flowered tree; a typical Terai tree.

Other trees include *Salmalia malabarica* (simal/silk cotton), *Ficus glomerata* (gular) and *Terminalia arjuna* (arjun).

**Importance:** The Terai vegetation shelters the one-horned rhinoceros, Bengal tiger, elephant and swamp deer, and provides fuel, timber, timber products and grazing land for the densely populated southern plain.
questions.knowledgeNote: The Terai carries tall mixed deciduous and sal forest; shisham, babar, narikhaj and sal are its signature trees.
